<objective>
Rewire `upload-modal.component.ts`/`.html`/`.scss` to consume the four pieces built in Plans 02/04/06: embed `<app-measurement-ruler>` (with `showDirection=false` — upload-modal has no directional decoration) and `<app-attachment-point-picker>` in place of the inline ruler SVG and crosshair-overlay markup; delegate `onFileSelected` to `UploadImagePipelineService.processFile`; compose `initializeForm`'s validators from `UploadFormValidatorsService`. This completes DECOMP-01: "image processing, ruler/measurement UI, and form handling in separate components/services" with unchanged upload behavior.

Everything that stays on the shell (per D-01/D-03 "parent owns form writes and object construction"): `uploadForm` creation/composition, `onSubmit`'s `ImageModel` construction (including `attachmentPoint`/`measurementLine` inclusion rules), `resetForm`, `toggleAdvancedSettings`, category/model-type getters, unit toggling, `isProcessingImage`/`cropResult`/`compressionResult`/`error` fields (now POPULATED from the pipeline service's result rather than computed inline), and the `@Input()`/`@Output()` public contract (`isOpen`, `close`, `upload`) which callers (`app.component.ts`) depend on unchanged.

Purpose: Finish DECOMP-01's decomposition without changing `upload-modal`'s external contract or the ImageModel it emits.
Output: Thinned `upload-modal` shell embedding the shared ruler/picker components and delegating to the two Plan 06 services.
</objective>

  <action>
    Edit `upload-modal.component.ts` in place. Update the `imports` array in the `@Component` decorator to include `MeasurementRulerComponent` and `AttachmentPointPickerComponent` (Plan 04) alongside the existing `CategoryDropdownComponent`. Inject `UploadImagePipelineService`, `UploadFormValidatorsService`, `MeasurementRulerService`, and `AttachmentPointDefinitionService` in the constructor (removing the now-redundant direct `ImageProcessingService` injection if the pipeline service fully wraps it — keep it only if `onSubmit`/other retained methods still call it directly). Rewrite `initializeForm()` to compose validators via `this.uploadFormValidators.uniqueNameValidator()`, `this.uploadFormValidators.sliderRangeValidator()`, and `this.uploadFormValidators.heightValidator(() => this.currentUnit)` in place of the private method references — remove the three now-dead private validator methods (`uniqueNameValidator`, `sliderRangeValidator`, `heightValidator`). Rewrite `onFileSelected(event)` to extract the `File` from the event, call `this.uploadImagePipeline.processFile(file, { autoCropEnabled: this.uploadForm.get('autoCropEnabled')?.value, cropTolerance: ..., compressionEnabled: ..., compressionQuality: ..., maxDimension: ... })`, set `this.isProcessingImage` around the await, and on the result populate `this.selectedFile`, `this.previewUrl`, `this.cropResult`, `this.compressionResult`, `this.error`, and `this.uploadForm.patchValue({ name: result.suggestedName })` (only when `result.error` is null, matching current behavior where the name is set before processing begins — verify against the read file and preserve the exact ordering/timing of the name patch relative to processing). Remove `createPreviewFromFile`/`applyCompression` (now inside the pipeline service) but KEEP `reprocessCurrentFile`/`toggleAutoCrop`/`toggleCompression`/`formatFileSize` on the shell (they orchestrate re-invoking `onFileSelected`, which is shell-owned). Remove the ruler drag methods (`onRulerPointMouseDown/TouchStart/Move/End`, `updateRulerPixelLength`, `setRulerPreset`, `getScaledRulerX/Y`) and the `boundOnRulerMove`/`boundOnRulerEnd`/`isDraggingRulerPoint` fields — the embedded `<app-measurement-ruler>` component now owns dragging. Rewrite `initializeDefaultRuler()` to call `this.measurementRulerService.presetLine('vertical', this.previewImageElement)` and assign the result to `this.measurementLine` (keep the method name — `onImageLoad` still calls it). Replace `isDefaultVerticalRuler(dimensions)` call sites in `onSubmit` with `this.measurementRulerService.isDefaultVerticalRuler(this.measurementLine, dimensions)`. Remove `startDefiningAttachmentPoint`/`cancelDefiningAttachmentPoint`/`onImageClick` (now inside `<app-attachment-point-picker>`); add a handler `onPointPlaced({x, y})` that constructs `this.attachmentPoint = { id: 'attachment-point', name: 'Attachment Point', x, y, type: 'custom' }` and calls `this.uploadForm.patchValue({ isPenetrationZone: false, penetrationAngle: 0 })` (Pitfall 1/5 — this side effect stays on the shell) and set `this.isDefiningAttachmentPoint` via a `definingChange` handler. Keep `ngOnDestroy` but simplify its ruler-listener cleanup to call `this.measurementRulerService.stopDragDefensively()` instead of direct `document.removeEventListener` calls. Keep `onSubmit`, `getImageDimensions`, `resetForm`, `onClose`, `toggleAdvancedSettings`, `onCategoryChange`, `onModelTypeChange`, `toggleUnit`, and all getters (`canDefineAttachmentPoint`, `isAttachmentPointRequired`, `isSubmitDisabled`, `showCropResult`, `cropResultText`, `showCropReduction`, `unitConfig`, `isImperialUnit`, `isMetricUnit`, `categoryType`) unchanged in behavior.
  </action>
